messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT • router-fallback-loop detected for dedicated pool 'dp-usw2-11' — elevated 502/503s and rapid fallback oscillation across variants. incident_id=INC-2026-0422, severity=sev2, page=eng-oncall :rotating_light:
Sam O'Neill: seeing same. 503 spikes starting ~2123456700, router routes to variant-v2 which is failing health checks, falls back to v1, then back to v2 -> loop. traffic appears to be dropping for requests routed through dp-usw2-11.
Priya Raman: on it. pulling metrics now. can someone confirm dedicated autoscaler recently scaled dp-usw2-11 down?
Taylor (SRE): autoscaler logs show a scale-down at 2123456605 for pool dp-usw2-11 due to low avg_cpu signal from the pool-proxy. looks suspicious — downstream router was sending a stale capacity metric (cache TTL mismatch).
Sam O'Neill: confirmed, router read capacity_signal=0 for a subset of hosts in the pool even though nodes are healthy. suspect metric-lag between proxy and router.
Priya Raman: quick mitigation: disable smart-fallback policy for router group 'rg-usw2-dedicated' to stop variant oscillation. doing now: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/configs/routers/rg-usw2-dedicated/override -d '{"fallback_policy":"off"}'`
deploy-bot: override accepted (tx=0x7b3f). change id cfg-2026-0224-override.
Mei Chen: heads up to CS — customers hitting higher error rates. I see a support spike for us-west accounts, sending note to affected customers and pausing automated retries.
Jorge Alvarez: what's the user impact window? any SLA breaches?
Priya Raman: preliminary: ~5 self-serve customers + 2 enterprise tenants saw errors between 2123456720-2123457040. Error rate peaked ~18% for calls routed to dp-usw2-11. not an account-wide outage but elevated latencies and some 5xx.
Taylor (SRE): running quick query from metrics stack: ```
# prometheus
sum by(code) (rate(router_http_responses_total{pool=\"dp-usw2-11\"}[1m]))
# result shows 5xx jump at 2123456710
```
Sam O'Neill: root cause hypothesis: router reading stale capacity metrics (TTL mismatch on memcache), autoscaler reacts and shrinks pool -> routing tombstones appear -> requests routed to wrong/offline variant -> fallback triggers -> oscillation.
Priya Raman: temp fix steps applied: 1) disabled fallback policy 2) pinned router to variant-v1 for rg-usw2-dedicated 3) forced autoscaler pause for dp-usw2-11 (`/api/autoscaler/pause?pool=dp-usw2-11`) 4) cleared memcache for metric keys `metric:router:capacity:dp-usw2-11`
Sam O'Neill: I just bumped pool target size +3 manually: `rctl pool resize dp-usw2-11 --min 6 --max 12` — started warm nodes, waiting for readiness.
Taylor (SRE): nodes coming up; health checks green at 2123457012. Router capacity reads updated.
Mei Chen: CS update: sent targeted note to affected customers, offering priority monitoring for next 24h. ticket INC-2026-0422 created in zendesk and linked to internal incident.
Jorge Alvarez: follow-up actions we need in postmortem: - fix memcache TTL mismatch on router metrics pipeline - autoscaler safety check to ignore negative/stale signals - ensure fallback policy has cooldown / circuit-breaker - add synthetic smoke test in us-west after autoscale events
Priya Raman: creating a follow-up ticket in Jira: RDW-INC-2026-0422-POSTMORTEM, assigning to eng-runtime + eng-sre.
Sam O'Neill: handoff to Priya for the remainder of the incident window. I'm going offline in 10 to pick up paging rotation. Priya, drop a note when we re-enable fallback. :thumbsup:
Priya Raman: will re-enable controlled fallback after pool stable and metrics no longer show TTL holes. ETA ~30m. leaving detailed runbook steps here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/router-fallback (runbook v3)
deploy-bot: reminder: next scheduled config rollback window at 2123460000.
Taylor (SRE): logging timeline + snapshots to incident artifact store: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0422/ (metrics.json, router-configs.zip, autoscaler-logs.txt)
Mei Chen: note for CS: customers A123 and B567 reported retries succeeded after ~5m; no SLA credit expected but monitoring continues.
Priya Raman: last check: error rate for dp-usw2-11 down to 0.6% at 2123457160, latency back to baseline. re-enabling fallback in config with cooldown of 60s and circuit-breaker threshold=10%: `curl -X POST ... -d '{"fallback_policy": {"enabled": true, "cooldown_s": 60, "cb_threshold": 0.1}}'`
Sam O'Neill: thanks team. I'll add notes to oncall log and file a small follow-up patch for memcache TTL in the router agent. handing off final watch to Priya.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE • severity -> sev3 (mitigated) • incident closed for active paging, postmortem scheduled. incident_id=INC-2026-0422
Priya Raman: closing thread — will post the postmortem draft in #postmortems within 24h and link the Jira. thanks all. :heart:
